name: Comics, Manga and Anime
description: Comics, manga and anime from newspaper strips and Hokusai's sketches to Superman, Astro Boy, Marvel, Dragon Ball, Studio Ghibli and the superhero films of today.

checkpoints.name: Origins
checkpoints.note: Hokusai's sketchbooks give Japan the word manga, and picture stories and cartoons appear in European and American magazines.

checkpoints.name: Newspaper strips and the first anime
checkpoints.note: Comic strips fill the Sunday papers, and the first Japanese animated films are made.

checkpoints.name: The first superheroes
checkpoints.note: Superman and Batman appear, and comic books sell millions. In Japan, Osamu Tezuka starts modern manga.

checkpoints.name: Astro Boy and Marvel's heroes
checkpoints.note: Astro Boy becomes the first anime series on television, weekly manga magazines appear and Marvel creates Spider-Man and the X-Men.

checkpoints.name: Akira, Dragon Ball and graphic novels
checkpoints.note: Dragon Ball, Akira and Studio Ghibli take anime abroad, and graphic novels such as Maus and Watchmen win adult readers. Pokémon becomes a worldwide craze.

checkpoints.name: Heroes on screen and streaming
checkpoints.note: Spirited Away wins an Oscar, Marvel's films become the biggest series in film history, and anime such as Demon Slayer reaches the world by streaming.
